name: session_start
title: Start virtual KWin session
description: Start an isolated virtual KWin Wayland session (one at a time). Then launch apps with app_launch.

home.description: HOME for launched apps: the host HOME, or a temporary isolated XDG HOME. Not a security sandbox.

retention.description: What survives the session end, decided now and honoured by session_stop and server exit. Kept after session end. home needs home='isolated'.

anyOf.description: Workspace size, logical px.

retention.description: Kept after session end. home needs home='isolated'.

name: session_connect
title: Attach to live KDE desktop
description: Attach to an already running KWin session (the real desktop or a container). Actions then affect real applications; window_close asks the user first.

enable_accessibility.description: Set org.a11y.Status.IsEnabled for the session lifetime; restored by session_stop.

retention.description: What survives the session end, decided now and honoured by session_stop and server exit. Kept after session end. home needs home='isolated'.

anyOf.description: Workspace size, logical px.

retention.description: Kept after session end. home needs home='isolated'.

name: session_stop
title: End session
description: End the current session. Virtual: terminate KWin, launched apps and the bus. Live: detach, kill only apps launched through kwin-mcp, restore the a11y switch. Releases held input. Idempotent.

kept.description: Directories that survive the session end.

released.description: Mouse buttons and keys kwin-mcp holds pressed.

name: session_info
title: Session status
description: Report the current session (or null), its enabled backends, and every app launched through kwin-mcp.

anyOf.description: The running session.
Workspace size, logical px.

retention.description: Kept after session end. home needs home='isolated'.

items.description: One app launched through kwin-mcp in the current session.

held.description: Mouse buttons and keys kwin-mcp holds pressed.

name: app_launch
title: Launch app in session
description: Launch a program in the session (shlex-split, no shell). stdout/stderr go to a log read with app_log. A failed launch keeps the session.

command.description: Command line, e.g. "kate --new". Split with shlex; empty or unbalanced quotes is an error.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this process.

name: app_log
title: Read app output
description: Return the tail of the captured stdout/stderr of an app launched with app_launch.

pid.description: PID returned by app_launch (session_info lists them).

outputSchema.description: Result of app_log: the tail of an app's captured stdout/stderr.

name: screen_capture
title: Capture screen
description: Capture the workspace (or a rectangle of it) as PNG via KWin ScreenShot2 (Spectacle fallback). Returns the path and the image-to-logical coordinate mapping.

region.description: Crop rectangle in global logical px; null = whole workspace. Parts outside the workspace are dropped. Global logical px.

max_edge.description: Downscale so the longer side <= max_edge px; 0 = full resolution; null = server --screenshot-max-edge.

include_cursor.description: Draw the pointer into the image.

outputSchema.description: One saved PNG of the workspace (or of a region of it).

anyOf.description: Image px to logical px: logical = origin + image_px / scale.

name: element_query
title: Query accessibility elements
description: Return AT-SPI2 elements matching locator (pre-order) with rects, states, actions, window_id and a ref for targets. With wait, poll until present/absent.

locator.description: AND-ed filters; app/query/role case-insensitive, states = exact AT-SPI state names; {} = all.

max_depth.description: Depth limit: 0 (or less) = application nodes only, 1 = top-level windows.

wait.description: Omit = read now; set = poll until the condition holds. Poll until true; timeout returns satisfied=false.

outputSchema.description: Elements matching the locator, in pre-order.

locator.description: AND-ed filters; app/query/role case-insensitive, states = exact AT-SPI state names; {} = all.

items.description: One AT-SPI element; rect is global logical px, or null with the reason.

anyOf.description: Global logical px.
Outcome of an element_query wait.

name: element_act
title: Invoke element action
description: Invoke a named AT-SPI action on exactly one element: {ref}, or {strict: Locator} (strict search). Errors list the actions matches expose.

anyOf.description: A ref minted by element_query.
Strict: depth 64, fail-closed, exactly one (element, action).

strict.description: AND-ed filters; app/query/role case-insensitive, states = exact AT-SPI state names; {} = all.

action.description: AT-SPI action name, case-insensitive, e.g. "Press", "Toggle", "Activate" (or "|"-separated fallbacks, e.g. "Press|click").

capture.description: Frames taken delays_ms after the action ends; same options as screen_capture.

anyOf.description: One AT-SPI element; rect is global logical px, or null with the reason.
Global logical px.

items.description: One saved PNG of the workspace (or of a region of it).

anyOf.description: Image px to logical px: logical = origin + image_px / scale.

held.description: Mouse buttons and keys kwin-mcp holds pressed.

name: window_list
title: List windows
description: List KWin windows (incl. dialogs/popups/shell) with id, kind, frame/client rects, capabilities and desktops. filter fields are AND-ed.

filter.description: Same selector as the window mutators, used as a filter; null = every window. AND-ed filters over all windows; mutators need exactly one match (errors list ids and kinds).

outputSchema.description: Windows matching the filter, in KWin's window list order.

anyOf.description: AND-ed filters over all windows; mutators need exactly one match (errors list ids and kinds).

items.description: One KWin window.

name: desktop_list
title: List virtual desktops
description: List KWin virtual desktops in pager order with the current one marked.

items.description: One KWin virtual desktop; id is stable while the desktop exists.

name: window_focus
title: Activate window
description: Raise and activate exactly one window (workspace.activeWindow).

window.description: Must match exactly one window; an ambiguous match is an error listing candidate ids. AND-ed filters over all windows; mutators need exactly one match (errors list ids and kinds).

capture.description: Frames taken delays_ms after the action ends; same options as screen_capture.

outputSchema.description: Result of window_focus; window is observed after the activation.

anyOf.description: One KWin window.

items.description: One saved PNG of the workspace (or of a region of it).

anyOf.description: Image px to logical px: logical = origin + image_px / scale.

name: window_place
title: Move window
description: Set frame and/or virtual desktop of exactly one window, then read it back (KWin applies async). Refused with 'nothing was changed' when transients would also move.

window.description: Must match exactly one window; an ambiguous match is an error listing candidate ids. AND-ed filters over all windows; mutators need exactly one match (errors list ids and kinds).

frame.description: New outer frame, global logical px; omitted fields kept; size <= workspace. Omitted fields keep their value.

desktop.description: Move to this virtual desktop id (from desktop_list).

capture.description: Frames taken delays_ms after the action ends; same options as screen_capture.

outputSchema.description: Result of window_place, read back after KWin applied it.

anyOf.description: Omitted fields keep their value.
One KWin window.

before.description: The window's state when window_place was requested.

applied.description: Per requested part: true = observed applied; null = not requested.

items.description: One saved PNG of the workspace (or of a region of it).

anyOf.description: Image px to logical px: logical = origin + image_px / scale.

name: window_close
title: Close window
description: Ask exactly one window to close (app may refuse). On a live session the user must confirm; unconfirmed, not closeable or unknown = non-error refusal.

window.description: Must match exactly one window; an ambiguous match is an error listing candidate ids. AND-ed filters over all windows; mutators need exactly one match (errors list ids and kinds).

capture.description: Frames taken delays_ms after the action ends; same options as screen_capture.

outputSchema.description: Result of window_close; outcomes other than a request are refusals, not errors.

items.description: One saved PNG of the workspace (or of a region of it).

anyOf.description: Image px to logical px: logical = origin + image_px / scale.

name: clipboard_read
title: Read clipboard
description: Return the session clipboard text (wl-paste). Virtual sessions need enable_clipboard.

outputSchema.description: Result of dbus_call; signature is the reply's D-Bus signature ('' when void).
